5ed600b2.text:
Hello there again.  I'm Gubber Blump.

I hope you are doing real well.  I hope you are still fishing too.  I love fishing.  The Blump family is known for fishing.  Here is a bauble, so that you can fish a little better.  I love using them when I fish.  Good luck, and thank you again for helping me catch them groupers from before.

Keep on fishing!

Gubber Blump
5ed600b2.title: Plain Letter

10216|1147bc15.name: Gubber Blump
10216|1147bc15.text: ...pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried...

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11041|96c601a6.name: Milla Fairancora
11041|96c601a6.text: Elune-adore, my sister. You are welcome here. Speak, and I will do what I can to aid you.

11081|0772f862.name: Faldron
11081|0772f862.text: In time you will be ready for what I have to teach, $N. Until then, please ask Darianna over there to help you with your training.

11083|53d41aed.name: Darianna
11083|53d41aed.text: It's so exciting to be here in Darnassus, surrounded by talented people! I just know I'm going to make my family proud. Maybe if I'm really lucky, the Sentinels will ask me to join their forces on the front!

11799|afaf02f4.name: Tajarri
11799|afaf02f4.text:
May Cenarius watch over you, sister.

I am Tajarri, and I am a sworn protector of this shrine.  It is my honor to serve Keeper Remulos as a warden of this sacred land.

11800|2051e10a.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|2051e10a.text: Would you like a flight to Rut'theran Village, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11800|d5d73f6c.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|d5d73f6c.text:
In the northern part of Darkshore runs the Cliffspring River, flowing down from the lands now known as Felwood.  As the river flows out and empties out into the Mist's Edge, travel north to where the deepest parts of the ocean begin.  A stone formation that some call the Stone Claw due to its shape is where you may find what you seek.

Be warned - threshers gather by the Stone Claw, and will attack those who trespass on their territory.

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

12042|e653c173.name: Loganaar
12042|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1466|9e43c86b.name: Gretta Finespindle
1466|9e43c86b.text: Aww, what rotten luck! My skills aren't good enough to be of any use to you. Oh well. Talk to Fimble Finespindle over there by the loom. He's been working with leather for longer than I have.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1646|1d2a2e75.name: Baros Alexston
1646|1d2a2e75.text: Greetings, I am Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

258572|cad23935.name: Dani'ill
258572|cad23935.text: Many of the supplies that tradesmen need can be found in the world. For those that cannot, I provide a limited selection for fair price.

2930|cd94cda6.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
2930|cd94cda6.text: Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

3179|c2467ddc.name: Harold Riggs
3179|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4156|279d82d3.name: Astaia
4156|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

4159|21d3a052.name: Me'lynn
4159|21d3a052.text: What a fine day! It inspires me to create a new design.

4160|126c2b9a.name: Ainethil
4160|126c2b9a.text: This potion seems to heal less damage every time I brew it, though I use the same ingredients. There can be only one conclusion: the plants are changing. I cannot say why or into what.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4211|a28d29e1.name: Dannelor
4211|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4212|43a79d46.name: Telonis
4212|43a79d46.text: I regret to say that I cannot aid you, gentle lady, until you learn more of working with leather. Speak with Faldron or Darianna here instead. They can teach you the skill you require.

4217|34f0a84a.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
4217|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4218|34f0a84a.name: Denatharion
4218|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4219|34f0a84a.name: Fylerian Nightwing
4219|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

5127|dd957ca2.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|dd957ca2.text: Your skills are coming along nicely. Soon you'll be running a leather shop of your own. I'll be glad for the help, $N. My hands are only so fast, you know? There's so much work to do!

5150|942980f4.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|942980f4.text: Are you a student of the medical sciences?

5159|9af6c3de.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|9af6c3de.text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.

5595|02e0b463.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|02e0b463.text:
Looking to take a ride on a gryphon, now are ye?  Gryth Thurden is the one ye'll want to be seeing about that.  

Ye can find him on the eastern side of The Great Forge in the middle of Ironforge.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

6301|021e8521.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|021e8521.text: Greetings lass, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

7954|fd743840.name: Binjy Featherwhistle
7954|fd743840.text: You need to be exalted with the gnomes of the Gnomeregan Exiles before I will teach you how to pilot a Mechanostrider, $c.

7955|53cc47ec.name: Milli Featherwhistle
7955|53cc47ec.text: Erm... I really don't know you that well, sorry.  I mean, as an authorized Mechanostrider dealer, I really only can sell my mounts to those people who are considered exalted amongst the gnomes.  If you ever are recognized as exalted to Gnomeregan, I'd be happy to show you what I have to offer.

1002-progress.name: Unknown
1002-progress.text: Though you have yet to place the 6 Moonstalker Fangs inside, you believe you hear the sounds of static and incoherent gnome ramblings coming from within. Could someone else have fixed the machine already?
1002-progress.title: Buzzbox 323

1138-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1138-progress.text:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's about it.

Oh, hello there $N.  Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
1138-progress.title: Fruit of the Sea

1580-progress.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
1580-progress.text: Did you find any electropellers?  I'll need them if I'm to continue my research on duck decoys...
1580-progress.title: Electropellers

16-progress.name: Gerard Tiller
16-progress.text:
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.

If you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
16-progress.title: Give Gerard a Drink

176-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
176-progress.text: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men.  You have something to report about the beast?
176-progress.title: WANTED: "Hogger"

272-progress.name: Dendrite Starblaze
272-progress.text: Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, $N?  If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information.  Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.
272-progress.title: Trial of the Sea Lion

4725-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4725-progress.text:
It is a pleasure to see you again, $N.  We are making great strives in uncovering the mystery of why majestic sea creatures beach themselves on the Darkshore coastline, but with every question answered, two more are raised it seems.

Are you here to offer us more aid in our research?
4725-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4727-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4727-progress.text: Hello once again $N - have you found any more beached creatures that the Temple of the Moon should know about?
4727-progress.title: Beached Sea Turtle

4730-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4730-progress.text: Hello again, $N!  Are you here to report on another discovery?
4730-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

5061-progress.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
5061-progress.text:
Your return to Darnassus is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.

Do you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
5061-progress.title: Aquatic Form

84-progress.name: Billy Maclure
84-progress.text: Ugh... I'm starving!  Do you have that pie for me, $N?
84-progress.title: Back to Billy

86-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
86-progress.text:
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!

Do you have that boar meat?
86-progress.title: Pie for Billy

87-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found my necklace?
87-progress.title: Goldtooth

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

952-progress.name: Onu
952-progress.text: Ah.$c. How may Onu assist you?
952-progress.title: Grove of the Ancients

97914-progress.name: Baros Alexston
97914-progress.text:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
97914-progress.title: Expanding Horizons

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings, $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel
